ov: A large North American game bird, the heaviest of the chicken-like birds. Domestic turkeys come from a Mexican subspecies taken to Europe by the Spanish in the 16th century.
rg: Native to North America, including Mexico; domestic turkeys are farmed worldwide.
df: An omnivore; acorns and wild oats are favourites.
fx: Wild turkeys are fast, agile fliers, but the biggest domestic turkeys can barely fly.
